**Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action** — including clarifying questions, exploring the codebase, or checking files. If it turns out wrong for the situation, you don't have to use it.

When multiple skills apply, process skills come first — they set the approach, then implementation skills (frontend-design, etc.) carry it out. Brainstorming and systematic-debugging are Superpowers' most common process skills, but the rule holds for any of them.

# Unit economics: Moss Matcha Bar (an example: a walk-in matcha café)

Every number below comes from the input file. Nothing is looked up or guessed.

## One cup

| line | per cup |
| --- | ---: |
| Price | $6.50 |
| Matcha (ceremonial, 2g) | -$0.92 |
| Oat milk | -$0.38 |
| Cup, lid, straw | -$0.24 |
| Card fees | -$0.20 |
| **Contribution** (what each cup leaves to pay the fixed costs) | **$4.76** (73%) |

## The margin that matters

Fixed costs: $26,540 a month (Labour $15,500, Rent + utilities $11,040).

- **Break-even: 186 cups a day.** Below that you lose money every month.
- **Profit margin at your plan** (383 a day): **38%** of every sale, after every cost.
- Capacity: 600 a day.

## Year 1, month by month

| month | cups a day | revenue | profit | cumulative (after $25,280 startup) |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 140 | $27,300 | -$6,548 | -$31,828 |
| 2 | 170 | $33,150 | -$2,264 | -$34,092 |
| 3 | 195 | $38,025 | $1,306 | -$32,786 |
| 4 | 215 | $41,925 | $4,162 | -$28,624 |
| 5 | 235 | $45,825 | $7,018 | -$21,606 |
| 6 | 250 | $48,750 | $9,160 | -$12,446 |
| 7 | 262 | $51,090 | $10,874 | -$1,572 |
| 8 | 272 | $53,040 | $12,302 | $10,729 |
| 9 | 280 | $54,600 | $13,444 | $24,173 |
| 10 | 287 | $55,965 | $14,444 | $38,617 |
| 11 | 290 | $56,550 | $14,872 | $53,489 |
| 12 | 292 | $56,940 | $15,158 | $68,646 |

- **Year 1 operating profit: $93,926** on $563,160 of revenue.
- After the $25,280 startup spend: $68,646.
- Startup money earned back: month 8.
- Cash you need before it pays for itself: **$34,092**.

## What if

| scenario | margin at plan | break-even a day | year 1 profit |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Base plan | 38% | 186 | $93,926 |
| Price -10% | 31% | 216 | $37,610 |
| Volume -20% | 29% | 186 | $11,445 |
| Unit costs +15% | 34% | 197 | $71,313 |

No red flags in these numbers. They are only as good as the inputs: check every cost against a real quote.
